text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It happened again... Today's Bakushin
was far
from what I envisioned!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I wonder what happened to my legs...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Could it be I'll be stuck like this forever?
An
Umamusume who can't set an
example for
anyone?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Could it be I'll be stuck like this forever?
An
Umamusume who can't set an
example for
anyone?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your level of enthusiasm is on a different
level! As
is your dependability! Like a
divine entity sent to
cheer me up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's just as you said. Bakushin
comes
naturally to me! Yep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! If today is no good, there's
always
tomorrow! Let's go! BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was dangerous! I was moments
away from
being swallowed up by a turf
monster!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Vile monster! Are you trying to test the
class
representative?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I'll crush any evil monsters
with my
Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whether it be a god or a demon king! I'll
put an
end to them with my Bakushin!
